svg.title: seven.wav: 257 FFT bins squeezed into 40 mel bands
svg.desc: Top: the power spectrogram of the word seven with a linear frequency axis from 0 to 8000 hertz. Bottom: the log-mel spectrogram of the same clip, 40 mel bands. The lower frequencies, where the vowels' structure is, take up most of the mel picture; the upper half of the linear spectrogram is squeezed into the top few bands.

SPECTROGRAM (AFTER PRE-EMPHASIS), 257 BINS, LINEAR IN HZ
